name: Garden pot
line: Craftable from clay 1, stone 10 and a refined crystal. Alder teaches it in a story moment after the Larder room is restored.

name: Refined crystal
line: A quartz crystal smelted in the furnace. Needs a smelt recipe. It is the pot's refined input.

name: Heart events at 4, 8 and 10 hearts
line: The 2 and 6 heart events are built with draft text. The rest wait for the voice sheets (M3d). All heart rewards are plain items.

name: Secret Woods statue
line: The statue in the Secret Woods, after the pond species table (issue 878). The pond fish are built.

name: Cave pool water on mine floors
line: A fishable pool in the mines. No mine map has water yet.

name: Cosmetic village trees
line: Most trees in Hearthwell cannot be chopped. Needs tree objects in the Hearthwell map.

name: Mahogany monster seed
line: A way to find a mahogany seed from a monster. Needs the Secret Woods creatures.

name: Elderfruit from the spouse and the gallery set
line: Two of the seven elderfruit sources are still to build.

name: Harvest Showing judging
line: Crops are judged on the green and the prize counter opens. The festival itself is built; the judging is not.

name: Cake table dish picker
line: The cake table takes the held item today. A picker to choose a dish is still to build.

name: Lantern drift animation
line: The keepsake lantern floats by the rules. The drifting animation is not built.

name: Ice fishing counter on screen
line: The rules for ice fishing are built. The counter shown on screen is not.

name: Fish pond art
line: Pictures for ponds and their fish. Species numbers still need tuning in play.

name: Fish pictures
line: The game has no fish icons yet, so fish pages show a labelled box.

name: The ancestors' shrine
line: The Diamond's name, art and drops, the shrine tiles on the farm and the camp chest items are left.

name: The library gallery
line: A gallery where finds are donated, with the 40 donation and gallery set achievements.

name: Completion tracker lines and art
line: Real lines and art for the completion tracker, with the voice sheets.

name: Valley maps and festival layouts
line: The valley areas are shells today. Hand-authored layouts come after the owner's hands-on play.

name: Multiplayer
line: Milestone M4, after M3b.

name: The next region (ring 2)
line: Regions beyond the home valley, milestone M5.
